entities.name: Eduard Pechuël-Loesche
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Moritz Eduard Pechuël-Loesche,, was a German naturalist, geographer, ethnologist, painter, traveler, author, plant collector and Professor of Geography in Jena and Erlangen. Eduard was the eldest son of Ferdinand Moritz Pechuël, an innkeeper and mill owner, and Wilhelmine Lösche.
